newsitem.title: USA: Cambridge Bio ex-CFO charged with fraud.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Bio ex-CFO charged with fraud.

text.p: The U.S. Attorney's Office said Wednesday that it has charged Peter Hartman, the former chief financial officer of Cambridge Biotech Corp, with committing securities fraud in an alleged scheme to inflate revenues of the company.

In October 1996, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said it ordered Cambridge to cease and desist from violations of the antifraud, corporate reporting, books and record provisions of the U.S. securities laws.
The SEC said it found that between June 1991 and December 1992 the company improperly recognized revenues from a series of nine sales and license transactions.
The company, which has changed its name to Aquila Biopharmaceuticals and brought in new management subsequent to the federal probe, had no comment on the action against Hartman, 53.
